newsitem.title: UK: European VGO quiet, U.S. holiday closes arb intere.
newsitem.headline: European VGO quiet, U.S. holiday closes arb intere.

text.p: LONDON, European vaccum gas oil activity was slow on Friday with most buyers of high sulphur material maintaining that they do not need material until the second half of December.
Russian VGO supplies were also limiting price rises.
Low sulphur product was also quiet because of earlier trades. On Thursday a cargo sold at $167 cif NWE.
Traders said it was difficult to assess whether an arbitrage was open to the U.S.
"We will have to wait until Monday, the U.S. has shut up shop," said one trader.
